arms.ES: (1+8) evolution strategy: each candidate is the incumbent plus N(0, 0.5^2) noise on every non-zero learned parameter, plus (probability 0.5, always if empty) one new uniformly drawn feature with parameter N(0, 0.5^2); vocabulary additions as RS
arms.LOOP: Stage 3 condition C6f (Imp frozen at its initial value), unchanged
arms.RS: evidence-free random search: each candidate is the incumbent policy plus 1-3 signed steps, uniform on (0, 1.0), on learned parameters of features drawn uniformly from the visible vocabulary; vocabulary additions are drawn at random without reading evidence

contrasts.T1-P: LOOP - RS, round 32, one-sided exact Wilcoxon, alpha 0.01, pass if p < 0.01 and mean >= +0.5 pp

deviations_from_draft: RS draws revision size and step uniformly (1-3 steps, 0-1.0) rather than from the empirical revision-size distribution of the loop's proposer.
ES sigma and RS step were fixed a priori at 0.5 / 1.0 without tuning, rather than from development seeds, to save compute.
Missions run directly, not under the autonomy supervisor; autonomy is not under test.
Registration is this public GitHub commit and the protocol commit above, not an OSF entry.
Seed ranges were checked against the provided source archive and the published papers; lineages not in the archive could not be checked.
Hardware and library versions differ from Stage 3; validity was checked by reproduction (below) before freezing.
gate1: GO if bootstrap power of T1-P at n = 24 (10,000 resamples of the 8 pilot LOOP-RS differences) is >= 0.5 under the decision rule
shared: 8 candidates per round, 96 selection tasks, external audit on 300 fresh tasks (gain >= 0.02, sign test p <= 0.10), 12 evaluations per task, 32 rounds; train on the 12 Stage 3 development families, test on all 16 at rounds 0, 16, 32
status: frozen before any T1 mission was run
study: T1: outside baselines at matched budget

harness_equivalence.what: C6 seed 7101 run with the extended module (mission_t.py, no new features enabled) vs the frozen mission.py

stage3_reproduction.what: Four Stage 3 confirmatory missions rerun with the frozen code; compared with C3 v1.3 Table 24
